verdicts.matching_evidence:
Incorrect statement of the Betz limit

The paper states that no wind turbine can extract more than 89.3% of the kinetic energy in the wind stream and gives C_{p,Betz} = 16/27 ≈ 0.893. This is incorrect. The Betz limit is 16/27 ≈ 0.593, i.e., approximately 59.3%, not 89.3%.
